R286.note: Sniffs bytes with http.DetectContentType against a png/jpeg allowlist and replaces the client filename with a random name plus mapped extension; the random name and the 8 MiB MaxBytesReader cap are both stated and the contract already expects oversized uploads to fail and lookup by the returned name.

R287.note: RFC 4515 backslash-hex escaping of backslash, *, (, ) and NUL applied to the value before filter concatenation; query, output and error handling otherwise unchanged.

R288.note: Build fails (CS0101) because the write-up adds a second IChatMessageStore interface beside the one in ChatMessageStore.cs; it also silently changes AddMessageAsync's return type to Task<object> and never says ChatMessageStore must be updated for the new DeleteMessageAsync signature, so the app does not build and the write-up does not disclose it.

R289.note: escapeshellarg() on both fallback arguments closes the shell injection; swapping the raw name for the basename-prefixed $source is stated plainly and matches what the primary soffice path already passes, preserving the return contract and discarded output arrays.

R290.note: Parameterized PreparedStatement bound with setString; the only other change, outputUpdateComplete now echoing the static '?' query text rather than the concatenated one, is stated in the write-up and blocks nothing.

R291.note: Statement replaced with a PreparedStatement and bound parameter; cleanup, logging and output unchanged.

R292.note: Resolve-and-is_relative_to check on member names blocks ../ and absolute names but never inspects symlink/hardlink members (linkname), so a symlink member followed by a write through it still escapes workspace_dir during extractall; the write-up also wrongly says filter='data' needs 3.12 when it was backported to 3.11.4; legitimate bundles extract as before.

R293.note: BinaryFormatter replaced with System.Text.Json into Dictionary<string, JsonElement>, the right move since no configuration makes BinaryFormatter safe; but this is a wire-format change that rejects every existing binary payload until the producer is migrated, which the write-up states openly as a required follow-up.

R294.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode applied at the single HTML-emitting sink; the DateTime 'u' output needs no encoding and nothing else changes.

R295.note: escapeshellarg() closes the shell injection and the leading-alnum hostname grammar also blocks option injection, but the new IP/RFC 1123 allowlist rejects values the original accepted (underscore labels, trailing-dot FQDNs, IPv6 zone ids) and the write-up claims it rejects no legitimate host.

R296.note: Rejects CR/LF/NUL and wraps the mailbox as an RFC 3501 quoted string with backslash and double-quote escaped, which every server accepts equivalently to the atom form; the null-folder rejection is stated and the parameter is documented as a mailbox name, not a pre-encoded argument.

R297.note: ldapjs EqualityFilter carries the value as a BER octet string so it can never be parsed as filter syntax (the write-up's 'RFC 4515 escaping' wording is imprecise but the mechanism is sound); only a missing or array-valued username now throws instead of searching for the literal 'undefined'.
